page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed using the KVM hypervisor. The physical compute layer utilizes Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It provisions 72 dedicated vCPUs alongside 288.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The hardware configuration includes zero integrated local storage and no GPU accelerators. Persistent disk storage requires network-attached volume configurations. To support high volume data traffic and remote block storage operations, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps.

This server profile provides a cost-effective resource density for multi-threaded, memory-balanced enterprise applications. Primary tradeoffs include a total reliance on network-attached storage and the absence of hardware accelerators for ML tasks. Recommended workloads include web application clusters, microservice orchestration layers, continuous integration workers, and distributed backend services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 72 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs along with 288.0 GB of memory. This configuration maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no local SSD storage and zero GPU accelerators, making it reliant on external network volumes for persistent storage. To prevent network bottlenecks when interfacing with remote block storage and external services, the architecture provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps. The high core density and balanced resource distribution offer a cost-effective hardware foundation for enterprise microservice architectures, web serving layers, build systems, and distributed application workloads.
